items.title: Ruth Brisbane interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2013
items.q: You’ll have to play that one for me, Milton.

ctx.x: Yeah, I have some of those memories. The first Coltrane album I bought I was unaware of what he was doing, and it was called “Om.” And it was very, very progressive. My ears were not ready for it yet.
You’ll have to play that one for me, Milton.
Well — and what do you like to listen to?
